entries.186a220326c54dff: For 'Flat 35 (and Super Flat)', it has held the No.1 share on a loan disbursement count basis for 16 consecutive years. Because the loans it disburses are transferred or securitized to the Japan Housing Finance Agency and trust banks, it has a structure enabling it to operate as a fee business that limits credit risk and interest rate risk. Its sales system, which combines a network of 90 stores nationwide with non-face-to-face channels that do not require customers to visit, is also a feature.

entries.60c0b10c0af9b70b: The Medium-Term Management Plan 2025, formulated in May 2025, lists as key measures achieving an overwhelming No.1 share in 'Flat 35', investment in growth areas, and a stock revenue ratio above 50%. By expanding investment in its sales network and operations to advance DX, strengthening product development for new customer segments such as single, senior and foreign-national customers, and expanding the handling of housing loan guarantees for financial institutions nationwide through its guarantee business, which it co-invested in with the SBI Group, it plans to raise the proportion of stock revenue.
